dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There are many reasons why a samurai might draw their blade, but the principle is always the same: To do what they know in their heart is right.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though we walk a perilous path, where powerful foes face us at every turn, and though I cannot sense what lies at its end, I tread onwards with no fear in my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My mind is at ease, for I tread this path in your company.
